review_cost.rationale: One focused round of changes: 404 convention, the Filters history bug, and a few cleanups. Nothing structural; no rework.

findings.issue: Debounced effect compares local `search` state against the `q` prop; after browser Back/Forward the state is stale, so the timer re-fires router.replace and drags the URL back to the abandoned query, breaking history navigation after a search.
findings.suggestion: Sync local state when the URL changes (e.g. key the input off `useSearchParams().get('q')`, or reset state in an effect keyed on `q`), and only schedule a navigation when the change originates from typing.

findings.issue: 404 handling is hand-rolled: a catch-all route plus per-page `<NotFound />` returns, so every not-found page is served with HTTP 200 and the framework's `notFound()` + `not-found.jsx` convention is bypassed (the spec explicitly encouraged real 404s).
findings.suggestion: Delete the catch-all route, call `notFound()` from `next/navigation` where data is missing, and put the UI in `app/not-found.jsx` — this also gets the 404 status and noindex tag for free.

findings.issue: API failures throw with no `error.jsx` boundary anywhere, so a backend blip surfaces as Next's default 500 page.
findings.suggestion: Add a root `app/error.jsx` with a retry affordance.

findings.issue: `TypeBadge` is defined in and exported from `PokemonCard.jsx` but is a general primitive used by MovesSection, the type page and the move page; the card also renders its own `<li>`, leaking list structure into a leaf component.
findings.suggestion: Move `TypeBadge` to its own `components/TypeBadge.jsx` and let the parent own list markup.

findings.issue: `EvolutionNode` and `EvolutionList` are mutual one-line wrappers (each just calls the other), adding indirection without meaning.
findings.suggestion: Collapse into a single recursive component (the `<ul>` wrapper can live inside the same function).

findings.issue: Inline regex `entry.pokemon?.url?.match(/\/(\d+)\/?$/)` duplicates `idFromUrl` already exported from lib/format.js:38.
Home page fires 48 parallel pokemon fetches with `Promise.all` while `mapLimit` exists in lib/api.js:61 and is used everywhere else; inconsistent and unthrottled.
findings.suggestion: Use `mapLimit(pageSpecies, 12, ...)` for consistency with the rest of the data layer.

findings.issue: `promiseCache` never evicts successful entries, so memory grows with every distinct resource visited over the server's lifetime (bounded in practice by the API's finite catalog, but unbounded by design).
findings.suggestion: Acceptable given the spec explicitly permits in-memory caching; if kept, note the assumption in a comment or add a simple size cap.

findings.issue: `.map((row) => row)` is a no-op copy used only to avoid sorting the prop in place; it obscures intent.
devDependencies is empty — no ESLint setup, yet Filters.jsx:24 carries an `eslint-disable-next-line` comment; the disable is unverifiable in CI.
findings.suggestion: Add `eslint` + `eslint-config-next` and a lint script, or drop the comment if linting is intentionally out of scope.

summary: A tidy, recognisably idiomatic App Router implementation with a clean data layer, correct async params/metadata usage, and only two small client islands. The two things a reviewer will ask for are the hand-rolled 404 path (should be `notFound()` + `app/not-found.jsx`, which also yields the encouraged 404 status) and the stale-state bug in Filters that fights browser history after a search. Everything else is nits — merge after one focused round.
